title: Agent Configuration Pipeline
description: JSON Schema for agents.config.jsonc — validates the 6-phase configuration pipeline

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocompletion support

providers.description: Phase 1: Provider Detect — declare which model backend(s) agents use

agents.description: Phase 2: Agent Override / Merge / Remap — configure agent identity

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the agent

mode.description: Mode: 'primary' uses UI model selection; 'subagent' uses pinned model

model.description: Model identifier for subagent mode; null for primary mode

description.description: One-line description of the agent's role

toolFilters.description: Phase 3: Tool Filter — declare which tools each agent can use

allow.description: Tools agent is allowed to use (supports wildcards: mcp_*, *_session, etc.)

deny.description: Tools agent is NOT allowed to use (deny takes precedence over allow)

mcpServers.description: Phase 4: MCP Load — declare which MCP servers agents connect to

default.description: Default MCP servers for all agents

commands.description: Phase 5: Command Inject — declare slash commands available per agent

additionalProperties.description: Slash commands available to this agent

skills.description: Phase 6: Skill Compose — declare which skills each agent loads
